Betting and live

The app has the full Vantro market: AFL, NRL, cricket, racing, basketball and more. In-play odds update in real time, selected matches stream in the app, and you can build a same-game multi from one match in a few taps.

Money

Deposit with PayID, BPAY or a debit card; credit cards cannot be used for online wagering in Australia. Most PayID withdrawals land in about an hour, and the Wallet tab shows the status of every request.

Control

Log in with Face ID or a fingerprint. Deposit limits, activity statements and breaks are under Account, then Responsible gambling, and BetStop, the national self-exclusion register, is linked from the same screen.
